workingTitle: The PlayStation 6 stands to be ludicrously expensive as its production cost alone reportedly approaches $1000

secondary.title: The PlayStation 6 stands to be ludicrously expensive as its production cost alone reportedly approaches $1000
The PS6's memory and storage alone reportedly cost more than $680
The PlayStation 6’s Memory Components Alone Could Cost More Than $700

facts.context: But according to Wccftech, the cost of producing the RAM and SSDs for PlayStation 6 alone has reached around $680, which, combined with the rest of its proprietary custom-made state-of-the-art hardware, would easily push its production costs well above $1000.

In June, insider Kepler_L2 - who has previously made claims about hardware that have turned out to be true - claimed the console's bill of materials had climbed to close to $1,000, up from their earlier estimate of around $760.

singleSourced.context: This figure does not include packaging, shipping, retailer cuts, VAT and other taxes, imports, and so many other logistical nightmares that would make this console sell for closer to $2000.

As Wccftech writes, citing leaker KeplerL2, Sony was designing SoCs (the chips) when gDDR7 memory was expected to cost about $3 per GB, but nowadays that price is about seven times higher, between $20 and $23 per GB.
